hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern facilities, water, dump stations, or utility hook-ups on state forest lands') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29341 ('No Modern Amenities: There are no electric, water, sewer hook-ups, or dump stations on state forest land'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern conveniences on state forest lands such as dump stations, utility hook-ups, showers, or water') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29341 ('Campers are advised to bring their own water'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site (on Spruce Run Road 0.4 miles west of Running Gap Road). Gravel back-in driveway (listed driveway length 135 ft, slight grade), max vehicle length 30 ft. The tent pad is a short walk from the parking spur (listed 'Hike In Distance to Site: 5', spur 30 ft to the wheelstop, 'Distance from parking lot to site: Less than 300 feet').

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29341 ('Max Vehicle Length: 30', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Length: 135', 'Driveway Grade: Slight'), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/bald-eagle/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880266&siteId=29341 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed every stored value: no hookups/dump, single back-in site (005 Spruce Run Road) with a 30-ft max vehicle length, open year round, reservation required on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no showers/water and the driveway details. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
flags: Phone: the entry has only the 888-PA-PARKS reservation line; the Bald Eagle State Forest district office is 570-922-3344 (DCNR camping page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/bald-eagle/camping).
